---
title: "_panelB"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(skimr)
library(ggformula)
B <- read_csv("data/panel-B.csv")

```

```{r}
glimpse(B)
```

```{r}
inspect(B_mod)
```

```{r}
skim(B)
```
```{r}
B_mod <- B |>
  mutate(
    sex = as.factor(sex), smoke = as.factor(smoke), cvd = as.factor(cvd), area = as.factor(area), sc = as.factor(sc)
  )
glimpse(B_mod)
inspect(B_mod)
```

```{r}
B_mod |> gf_bar(~ sex)
B_mod |> gf_bar(~ smoke)
B_mod |> gf_bar(~ cvd)

B_mod |> gf_density(~ age)
B_mod |> gf_density(~ sc)
B_mod |> gf_density(~ carstair)
B_mod |> gf_histogram(~ area)

```

```{r}
B_mod |> gf_histogram(~ carstair, fill = ~ sex)

B_mod |> group_by(sex) |> summarize ( mean_carstair = mean(carstair, na.rm = T))
mosaic::t_test(carstair ~ sex, data = B_mod)
```

```{r}
vcd::structable(smoke ~ cvd, data=B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic()
#vcd::structable(smoke ~ sex, data=B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic()
vcd::structable(smoke ~ cvd, data=B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic(type = "expected")
#vcd::structable(smoke ~ sc, data=B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic(type = "expected")
#vcd::structable(cvd ~ sc, data = B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic(shade = TRUE)
vcd::structable(smoke ~ cvd, data = B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic(shade = TRUE)
#vcd::structable(sc ~ carstair, data = B_mod) |> vcd::mosaic(shade = TRUE) 

mosaic::xchisq.test(smoke ~ cvd, data=B_mod)
#mosaic::xchisq.test(smoke ~ sc, data=B_mod)
#B_mod |> gf_boxplot(age ~ smoke)
```
```{r}
# Deprivation score for people with and without CVD, split by social class
B_mod |>
  gf_boxplot(carstair ~ cvd, fill = ~ cvd) |>
  gf_facet_wrap(~ sc)

# Deprivation score by how much people smoke
B_mod |>
  gf_histogram(~ carstair, fill = ~ cvd) |>
  gf_facet_wrap(~ smoke)

B_mod |> gf_point(sc ~ smoke)
```
